independenceRationale: These are independent precision-optics injection-compression programmes with different authors, polymers and geometries. A 2023 plastic lens-array experiment measures optical path difference, displacement, birefringence and imaging quality, while a 2013 polystyrene and polycarbonate disk programme experimentally measures residual birefringence alongside simulation. They are separate experiments, not duplicate publications or re-analysis of the same data.
promotionClaim: Promote the mechanism-level statement that measured injection-compression and thermal history can alter residual birefringence, dimensional response and optical physical part-quality, requiring independent optical or stress metrology. Do not promote compression gap, timing, temperature, pressure, birefringence or displacement values as universal production settings or acceptance limits.
